translations.web: Therefore you will have no one who divides the land by lot in Yahweh’s assembly.
translations.bsb: Therefore, you will have no one in the assembly of the LORD to divide the land by lot.
translations.kjv: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the LORD.
translations.asv: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast the line by lot in the assembly of Jehovah.
